newsitem.title: USA: SafeGuard Health selling general practices.
newsitem.headline: SafeGuard Health selling general practices.

text.p: SafeGuard Health Enterprises said Thursday it is continuing its program to sell the company's general dental practices.
SafeGuard Healthsaid Thursday revenues for its second quarter ended June 30, 1997 rose 33.0 percent to $26.3 million from $19.8 million a year ago.

During the second quarter, four additional practices were sold -- resulting in a net gain of $0.6 million, which offsets a majority of the losses from its remaining discontinued operations. The company has also entered into a letter of intent for the sale of the remaining offices which is expected to close within the next 30 days.
Once completed, SafeGuard's practice management company will have 30 dental offices under contract for long-term practice management agreements.

"Our results for the quarter reflect continued improvement in all areas of our business, supported by margin improvements, a reduction in medical loss ratios to 67.2 percent and membership climbing to over 1,157,000 -- a 43.2 percent increase over the prior year," said chief exectutive Steven Baileys.
Dr. Baileys also added that the company completed its acquisition of Florida-based Advantage Dental Health Plans mid-quarter.
The company will realize the full benefit of the acquisition beginning in the third quarter of this year.
